import ast,base64,hashlib,json,math,time,zlib
from fractions import Fraction as F
from pathlib import Path
t=time.monotonic()
new=json.loads(Path('coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-REDUCTION-DETECTOR-RN64-001-CODEX.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
oldpath=Path('coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-SOURCE-PRODUCT-RN64-001-CODEX.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(oldpath.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='6be20bac7ddf52a4c8d167b92db2c576c03a81c45428d5fa7b95ac4577d1d9a8'
old=json.loads(oldpath.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for n,h in old['code_doc_sha256'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,n
def payload(r):
    run=r['run'];raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(run['stdout_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
    assert len(raw)==run['stdout_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==run['stdout_sha256']
    return json.loads(raw)
a=payload(new);paths=payload(old)['audit']['cases']
sources=payload(json.loads(Path('coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-QUARTER-SOURCE-OPS-001-CODEX.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')))['cases']
phase=payload(json.loads(Path('coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-PHASE-QUOTIENT-001-CODEX.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')))['audit']['cases']
units=payload(json.loads(Path('coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-UNIT-RN64-001-CODEX.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')))['audit']['cases']
def two(e):return F(2**e) if e>=0 else F(1,2**(-e))
def decode(w):
    assert type(w) is int and 0<=w<2**64;e=(w>>52)&2047;m=w&((1<<52)-1);assert e!=2047
    return (-1 if w>>63 else 1)*F(((1<<52)+m) if e else m)*two(e-1023-52 if e else -1074)
def nearest(q,w):
    assert ((w>>52)&2047) or w&((1<<52)-1)==0
    candidates=[]
    for v in {w,w-1,w+1,0,1,1<<63,(1<<63)+1}:
        if 0<=v<2**64 and ((v>>52)&2047)!=2047:candidates.append((abs(q-decode(v)),v&1))
    assert (abs(q-decode(w)),w&1)==min(candidates)
    return decode(w)
nodes=0
def node(n,a,b,op,label):
    global nodes
    assert n['op']==op and n['label']==label and [F(*v) for v in n['inputs_rational']]==[a,b]
    exact=a+b if op=='add' else a*b;y=nearest(exact,n['output_uint64']);d=y-exact
    assert F(*n['rounding_delta_rational'])==d;nodes+=1
    return y,d,n['output_uint64']
def detector(d,y):
    re,im=y;ops=d['operations'];assert len(ops)==d['RN64_operations']==3
    rr,dr,_=node(ops[0],re,re,'mul','detector.real_square')
    ii,di,_=node(ops[1],im,im,'mul','detector.imag_square')
    q,ds,w=node(ops[2],rr,ii,'add','detector.combine')
    b=abs(dr)+abs(di)+abs(ds)
    assert d['output_uint64']==w and F(*d['observed_power_rational'])==q
    assert F(*d['detector_error_upper_rational'])==b
    assert F(*d['actual_detector_error_rational'])==abs(q-re*re-im*im)<=b
    return q,b
def relative(r,n,e,budget):
    lower=max(F(0),n-e);upper=e/lower if lower>0 else None
    assert F(*r['observed_rational'])==n and F(*r['absolute_error_upper_rational'])==e
    assert F(*r['ideal_reference_lower_rational'])==lower and F(*r['relative_budget_rational'])==budget
    assert r['relative_error_upper_rational']==([upper.numerator,upper.denominator] if upper is not None else None)
    assert r['relative_budget_satisfied']==(upper is not None and upper<=budget)
    return r['relative_budget_satisfied']
tree=ast.parse(Path('Blender/tests/test_axial_quarter_source_ops_cpu.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
run=next(x for x in tree.body if isinstance(x,ast.FunctionDef) and x.name=='run')
opts=next(x.value for x in run.body if isinstance(x,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(v,ast.Name) and v.id=='opts' for v in x.targets))
keys=['field_budget','intensity_budget','field_relative_budget','intensity_relative_budget'];static={}
for k,v in zip(opts.keys,opts.values):
    if not isinstance(k,ast.Constant) or k.value not in keys:continue
    assert isinstance(v,ast.Call) and isinstance(v.func,ast.Name) and v.func.id=='F' and len(v.args)==2
    numerator=v.args[0];den=v.args[1];assert isinstance(numerator,ast.Constant) and numerator.value==1
    if isinstance(den,ast.Constant):dv=den.value
    else:
        assert isinstance(den,ast.BinOp) and isinstance(den.op,ast.Pow) and den.left.value==10 and den.right.value==6;dv=10**6
    static[k.value]=F(1,dv)
assert static=={'field_budget':F(1,10000),'intensity_budget':F(1,5000),'field_relative_budget':F(1,10**6),'intensity_relative_budget':F(1,10**6)}
piL=F('3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937510')
piH=F('3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937511')
def oracle_path(name,idx):
    ph=phase[name]['paths'][idx];up=units[name]['paths'][idx]
    orig=F(*ph['original_length_BU'])/F(*ph['wavelength_BU_rational'])
    u=orig-ph['selector']['CPU_integer_turn']-F(up['quarter_CPU_index'],4)
    x=(piL+piH)*u;assert abs(x)<=1
    cc=sum((F((-1)**j)*x**(2*j)/math.factorial(2*j) for j in range(21)),F(0))
    ss=sum((F((-1)**j)*x**(2*j+1)/math.factorial(2*j+1) for j in range(20)),F(0))
    k=up['quarter_CPU_index']%4
    c,s=([cc,ss] if k==0 else ([-ss,cc] if k==1 else ([-cc,-ss] if k==2 else [ss,-cc])))
    z=[F(*v) for v in paths[name]['paths'][idx]['source_original_rational']]
    f=[-z[0]*c+z[1]*s,-z[0]*s-z[1]*c]
    e=sum(map(abs,z),F(0))*(abs(x)**41/math.factorial(41)+abs(x)**42/math.factorial(42)+2*abs(u)*(piH-piL))
    return f,e
cases=a['audit']['cases'];assert set(cases)==set(paths)
field_oracles=0;power_oracles=0;group_count=0
for name,c in cases.items():
    previous=paths[name];src=sources[name]
    assert c['previous_full_case_accepted']==previous['previous_full_case_accepted']
    for key in ['original_scene_binding_sha256','decoded_scene_binding_sha256']:assert c[key]==previous[key]
    for flag in ['accepted_full_field_pipeline','GPU_executed','ALU_executed','native_promotion_allowed','execution_authenticated','old_scene_unit_product_or_suites_rerun']:assert c[flag] is False
    if not previous['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only']:
        assert not c['scene_field_reduced'] and not c['detector_evaluated'] and c['RN64_operations']==0 and not c['ports']
        continue
    assert c['scene_field_reduced'] and c['detector_evaluated']
    fb=F(*src['transport']['field_absolute_L1_budget']);pb=F(*src['transport']['intensity_absolute_budget'])
    if 'reduction' in src:
        frs={F(*g['relative_field']['relative_budget_rational']) for p in src['reduction']['ports'].values() for g in p['groups'].values()}
        prs={F(*p['relative_intensity']['relative_budget_rational']) for p in src['reduction']['ports'].values()};assert len(frs)==len(prs)==1
        fr=frs.pop();pr=prs.pop();assert c['budgets']['origin'].startswith('retained reducer')
    else:
        assert name in ['nonquarter_FAIL','near_quarter_FAIL'];fr=static['field_relative_budget'];pr=static['intensity_relative_budget']
        assert fb==static['field_budget'] and pb==static['intensity_budget'] and 'defaults parsed AST' in c['budgets']['origin']
    assert {k:F(*c['budgets'][k]) for k in ['field','power','relative_field','relative_power']}=={'field':fb,'power':pb,'relative_field':fr,'relative_power':pr}
    grouped={}
    for idx,row in enumerate(previous['paths']):grouped.setdefault((row['port'],row['coherence_group']),[]).append((idx,row))
    assert set(grouped)=={(p,g) for p,pp in c['ports'].items() for g in pp['groups']}
    group_values={};valid=True;count_before=nodes
    for key,rows in grouped.items():
        port,group=key;g=c['ports'][port]['groups'][group];assert g['source_ids']==[r['source_id'] for _,r in rows]
        assert g['phase_reference_id']=='ideal-scene-source-gauge:'+c['original_scene_binding_sha256']
        y=[F(0),F(0)];exact=[F(0),F(0)];rbound=F(0);pbound=F(0);ideal=[F(0),F(0)];oracle_tail=F(0)
        assert len(g['steps'])==len(rows)
        for step,(idx,row) in zip(g['steps'],rows):
            z=[decode(w) for w in row['measurement']['output_uint64']]
            assert step['source_id']==row['source_id'] and len(step['operations'])==2
            for i in range(2):
                y[i],delta,_=node(step['operations'][i],y[i],z[i],'add','reduce.'+str(i));rbound+=abs(delta);exact[i]+=z[i]
            pbound+=F(*row['composed_path_field_error_L1_upper_rational'])
            f,e=oracle_path(name,idx);ideal=[a+b for a,b in zip(ideal,f)];oracle_tail+=e
        assert [decode(w) for w in g['output_uint64']]==y==[F(*v) for v in g['observed_field_rational']]
        actual=sum((abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(y,exact)),F(0))
        assert F(*g['actual_reduction_error_rational'])==actual<=rbound
        e=pbound+rbound;n=sum(map(abs,y),F(0))
        assert F(*g['path_error_upper_rational'])==pbound and F(*g['reduction_error_upper_rational'])==rbound
        assert F(*g['composed_field_error_upper_rational'])==e
        actual_original=sum((abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(y,ideal)),F(0));assert actual_original+oracle_tail<=e,name
        field_oracles+=1
        field_rel=relative(g['relative_field'],n,e,fr)
        assert g['field_absolute_pass']==(e<=fb);valid=valid and e<=fb and field_rel
        q,detbound=detector(g['detector'],y)
        transport=2*n*e+e*e;be=transport+detbound
        assert F(*g['transport_power_error_upper_rational'])==transport and F(*g['group_power_error_upper_rational'])==be
        ideal_power=sum((v*v for v in ideal),F(0))
        ideal_power_tail=2*sum(map(abs,ideal),F(0))*oracle_tail+oracle_tail*oracle_tail
        group_values[key]=(q,be,ideal_power,ideal_power_tail);group_count+=1
    for port,p in c['ports'].items():
        value=F(0);b=F(0);addb=F(0);ideal=F(0);tail=F(0)
        steps=p['add_steps'];assert len(steps)==len(p['groups'])
        for i,group in enumerate(p['groups']):
            q,be,iq,it=group_values[(port,group)]
            value,delta,w=node(steps[i],value,q,'add','port.incoherent_sum');addb+=abs(delta);b+=be;ideal+=iq;tail+=it
        b+=addb
        assert p['observed_power_uint64']==w and F(*p['observed_incoherent_power_rational'])==value
        assert F(*p['port_sum_error_upper_rational'])==addb and F(*p['composed_power_error_upper_rational'])==b
        assert abs(value-ideal)+tail<=b,name;power_oracles+=1
        power_rel=relative(p['relative_power'],value,b,pr)
        assert p['power_absolute_pass']==(b<=pb);valid=valid and b<=pb and power_rel
    assert c['RN64_operations']==nodes-count_before and c['accepted_reduction_detector_CPU_only']==valid
for name,m in a['primitives'].items():
    if name=='power_underflow_rounds_zero_charged':detector(m,[F(1,2**600),F(0)])
    elif name=='port_sum_loses_small_group_charged':node(m['operations'][0],F(1),F(1,2**60),'add','synthetic.port_sum')
    else:raise AssertionError(name)
assert a['audit']['RN64_operations']==84 and nodes==88 and group_count==13 and field_oracles==13 and power_oracles==12
assert not cases['exact_dark_zero_FAIL']['accepted_reduction_detector_CPU_only']
assert cases['relative0_FAIL']['budgets']['relative_field']==[0,1] and not cases['relative0_FAIL']['accepted_reduction_detector_CPU_only']
g=cases['dark']['ports']['D']['groups']['g'];p=cases['dark']['ports']['D']
real_field=abs(F(*g['observed_field_rational'][0])+F(1,2**30))/F(1,2**30)
real_power=abs(F(*p['observed_incoherent_power_rational'])-F(1,2**60))/F(1,2**60)
print(json.dumps({'validated':True,'elapsed_s':time.monotonic()-t,'pins':len(old['code_doc_sha256']),'RN64_nodes':nodes,
 'original_group_field_oracles':field_oracles,'original_port_power_oracles':power_oracles,
 'partial_reduction_detector_pass':sum(c['accepted_reduction_detector_CPU_only'] for c in cases.values()),
 'previous_fullcase_accepted':sum(c['previous_full_case_accepted'] for c in cases.values()),'previous_FAIL':sum(not c['previous_full_case_accepted'] for c in cases.values()),'full_field_promotions':0,
 'dark_field_relative_actual_approx':float(real_field),'dark_power_relative_actual_approx':float(real_power),
 'dark_field_relative_bound_approx':float(F(*g['relative_field']['relative_error_upper_rational'])),
 'dark_power_relative_bound_approx':float(F(*p['relative_power']['relative_error_upper_rational'])),
 'raw_sha256':new['run']['stdout_sha256']},sort_keys=True))
